speaker: abel_garnish
text: Five mornings, masters, and Wednesday is the apparel. The window, if the ladder will bear a man who will not hang upon the farewell.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The ladder will bear me. Nick, from the casement, and under it. I am not leaving your face.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can hold it if I come in under the note, sir. If I come in on it, it goes.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then stay a full third below every queen you have pitched since you were eleven. On the breath, not on the height. She is fourteen, not a whistle.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let the cold stay in the voice. The window is open on a garden. She need not sound as if the house had warmed her.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: How long at the foot before the Lady knocks? If I tarry, Arthur is through the arras on my back.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: I come when Master Garnish points the pin, Master Burbage. Mistress Pope has let this hem down twice. There is no more hem.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: One Lady, as we settled it. I have headed Arthur's roll Lady all through. Let no man call for Mother in the dark.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two breaths at the foot, Dick, and then off by the south door before she enters. Eight lines of the window. We are not buying the whole orchard. I must be at Paul's before eleven.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am not going to show you the sorrow of it. The sorrow is in the words, if I am in tune.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You went up on the name the last time you were proud of having it. Come in under, and let the name be his. Nobody is to startle him. John's order stands.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am not startled. I am cold. The doublet wants easing at the chest, and I will not discuss the chest. I will discuss the cue. Once more, under.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: When you have finished spending the boy, the Nurse can stop a yard, if I am let. How much of her on Saturday is allowed to be funny?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not this morning, Thomas. Wednesday is the whole tragedy in apparel. Leave something for Saturday. I will not settle her in a cold tiring-house with Navarre still to play.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I am seven-and-twenty. If I look like a man playing a boy, the run is the disguise. You told me to play him at a run. I have been doing it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then run inside these eight lines, and stop. Not the kiss. Not the morning after. Navarre is at two, and Navarre does not die of anything.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Two hours and a half for the court roll, and the thumb-biting in the first scene is already out. I am not timing a tomb today. Wednesday, with the gowns on and the bier carried.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: If I grow before Saturday the yard will have my garter. I am fourteen. The skirt has noticed.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Never mind the shins. Nick, when the father storms, save your breath. Let the room be loud, and let the girl be the quiet in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The louder the father, the quieter she may answer. A yard leans in for what it cannot quite hear.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I know where to save it, sir. The vial is on the fourth sheet. The window is only the spending of the night.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Citizens' wives on Saturday, Will. The gowns went with the term on Friday. Wives lean in. Lawyers lean back and talk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wives, then. I am buying nothing at Paul's. Take it once from Arthur's knock before I go.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: From the knock, boy. Mind the arras does not catch the sleeve.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: From the knock, Master Garnish.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am ready on the bed-stock.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Breathe first, Nick. Let the knock finish before you speak.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once, and then I am gone. Augustine, if he climbs on the name, stop him on that word and nowhere else. I want one fault, not a general fear.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: One fault. The name. I will stop it, and I will not invent a second to be useful.
